about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Young Kim

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL FRAUD ENFORCEMENT DIVISION ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NATIONAL FRAUD ENFORCEMENT DIVISION ACT OF 2026
sentences: Madam Speaker, I am proud to stand today in strong support of the National Fraud Enforcement Division Act.
I have been working to better coordinate our Federal response to fraud with my No More SCAMS Act, and I am proud to support this ironclad effort to hold these criminals accountable.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR THE CONDEMNATION AND DENOUNCEMENT OF SOCIALISM IN ALL ITS FORMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR THE CONDEMNATION AND DENOUNCEMENT OF SOCIALISM IN ALL ITS FORMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
sentences: My family fled poverty and a bitter lack of opportunity, and my mother- in-law crossed the DMZ multiple times to rescue loved ones who were trapped under tyranny in North Korea.
Read them for yourself on the DSA website: abolish the U.S. Senate, replace the Presidency, dismantle the Supreme Court, and rewrite our Constitution.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H. Res. 1490 so that this generation of Americans is not fooled by the empty promises of socialism and future generations never pay the price that families like mine already have.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
statements.title: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, over 80 percent of Americans believe Members of Congress shouldn't be trading stocks and benefiting off insider information.
Yet, while Americans have made their position clear, some Members of Congress and their families made more than 13,000 stock trades worth more than $600 million last year.
That is why I am proud to rise in strong support of this Stop Insider Trading Act to restore trust in Congress and bring accountability that the American people are asking for.
Stopping insider trading should be the easiest decision we make this week.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: URSULA ELLEN KENNEDY POST OFFICE BUILDING
statements.title: URSULA ELLEN KENNEDY POST OFFICE BUILDING
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 3350, to designate a post office in the city of Tustin, California, as the Ursula Ellen Kennedy Post Office Building.
Mr. Speaker, I thank the Kennedy family for working with me on this bill, and I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 3350.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY ACT
statements.title: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY ACT
sentences: After years of inaction, my home State of California has earned an F in housing affordability.
That relief, combined with the provisions in the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, will bring the dream of homeownership closer to reality for working families in my district.
For the first time since 2006, we are unlocking new capital that financial institutions can invest in affordable housing and community development projects.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO AID FOR GHOST STUDENTS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NO AID FOR GHOST STUDENTS ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I thank Congressman Burgess Owens for introducing this very commonsense legislation, and I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEVELOPING OVERSEAS MINERAL INVESTMENTS AND NEW ALLIED NETWORKS FOR CRITICAL ENERGIES ACT
statements.title: DEVELOPING OVERSEAS MINERAL INVESTMENTS AND NEW ALLIED NETWORKS FOR CRITICAL ENERGIES ACT
sentences: They enable fighter jets, semiconductors, batteries, and energy infrastructure.

I also thank Congressman Rob Wittman for his leadership on strengthening our defense industrial base, and Congressman John Moolenaar for confronting the challenges posed by the Chinese Communist Party.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 7037, the Developing Overseas Mineral Investments and New Allied Networks for Critical Energies, or DOMINANCE Act.
That is why Representative Bera and I introduced the bipartisan DOMINANCE Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ALLIED DEFENSE SALES ACT
statements.title: ALLIED DEFENSE SALES ACT
sentences: As a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee's Foreign Military Sales Task Force, I am proud to cosponsor this bipartisan bill introduced by our task force chair, Representative Zinke.
A partner nation would agree to serve as the lead nation to enable a multinational procurement, ensuring other qualified allies are able to participate in important foreign military sales.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 8665, the Allied Defense Sales Act.
I urge my colleagues to join me in supporting its passage.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRODUCING RETURNS AND OPPORTUNITY FOR INVESTMENT AND TRADE ACT OF 2026
statements.title: PRODUCING RETURNS AND OPPORTUNITY FOR INVESTMENT AND TRADE ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 5248, the Producing Returns and Opportunity for Investment and Trade Act, or PROFIT Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT THE PRESIDENT SHOULD PRIORITIZE SECURING THE RELEASE OF PASTOR JIN MINGRI, PASTOR GAO QUANFU AND HIS WIFE
statements.title: EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT THE PRESIDENT SHOULD PRIORITIZE SECURING THE RELEASE OF PASTOR JIN MINGRI, PASTOR GAO QUANFU AND HIS WIFE PANG YU, DR. GULSHAN ABBAS, AND...
sentences: This resolution sends a very clear message: The United States will not be silent while the Chinese Communist Party continues to detain, torture, and disappear innocent people, including family members of American citizens.
I rise in strong support of H. Res. 1259.

As President Trump prepares to engage directly with Xi Jinping this week, we urge for the prioritization of the immediate and unconditional release of Pastor Jin Mingri; Pastor Gao Quanfu and his wife, Pang Yu; Dr. Gulshan Abbas; Jimmy Lai; and all others justly detained.
We reject the CCP's reign of terror.
We stand with every freedom- loving people in Hong Kong, Xinjiang, Tibet, and across China who dreams of a day when faith is not a crime and truth is not censored.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this resolution, and I urge the administration to make the release of these individuals a priority in engaging with Beijing.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ARMENIAN GENOCIDE REMEMBRANCE DAY
statements.title: ARMENIAN GENOCIDE REMEMBRANCE DAY
sentences: I will continue to stand with the Armenian community, and I will work to ensure that the promise of ``never again'' is upheld. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HARNESSING ENERGY AT THERMAL SOURCES ACT OF 2026
statements.title: HARNESSING ENERGY AT THERMAL SOURCES ACT OF 2026
sentences: This means more American energy coming online faster, lower energy costs for working families, and a stronger domestic supply chain that doesn't depend on adversaries like China.
Mr. Speaker, I thank the chairman for yielding, and I rise in support of my bill, H.R. 5587, the Harnessing Energy At Thermal Sources Act or the HEATS Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the HEATS Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENHANCED IRAN SANCTIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: ENHANCED IRAN SANCTIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 1422) to impose sanctions with respect to persons engaged in logistical transactions and sanctions evasion relating to oil, gas, liquefied natural gas, and related petrochemical products from the Islamic Republic of Iran, and for other purposes, as amended.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H.R. 1422, the Enhanced Iran Sanctions Act.
For decades, the Iranian regime has brutally suppressed its own people while exporting terror across the globe.
On February 28, under President Trump's leadership, U.S. Central Command launched Operation Epic Fury after Iran rejected diplomatic off-ramps and refused to dismantle its nuclear program.
These actions are funded by Iran's illicit oil and gas sales, and now is the time to cut off its revenue streams.
H.R. 1422 strengthens secondary sanctions on entities that are enabling Iran to evade existing restrictions and profit from its petroleum trade.

The title of the bill was amended so as to read: ``A bill to impose sanctions with respect to persons engaged in significant transactions related or incidental to the processing, refining, export, transfer or sale of oil, condensates, or other petroleum or petrochemical products in whole or in part from the Islamic Republic of Iran.''.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Federal law enforcement is securing our borders against narcoterrorists.
I urge my colleagues to choose patriotism over partisanship and fund the Department of Homeland Security immediately.

statements.title: RELIEF FOR EARLY ON-SET ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE
sentences: The BRIDGE for YOAD Act fixes this gap by eliminating the Medicare waiting period for those with young-onset Alzheimer's.
Mr. Speaker, today I rise in support of my bill, the BRIDGE for Young Onset Alzheimer's Disease Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the BRIDGE for YOAD Act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY ACT
statements.title: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY ACT
sentences: After years of inaction, my home State of California has earned an F in housing affordability.
That relief, combined with the provisions in the Housing for the 21st Century Act, will bring the dream of homeownership closer to reality for working families in my district.
For the first time since 2006, we are finally increasing the capital that financial institutions can invest in affordable housing and community development projects.
I rise today in support in the Housing for the 21st Century Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISAPPROVING THE ACTION OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA COUNCIL IN APPROVING THE D.C. INCOME AND FRANCHISE TAX CONFORMITY AND REVISION TEMPORARY AMENDMENT ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DISAPPROVING THE ACTION OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA COUNCIL IN APPROVING THE D.C. INCOME AND FRANCHISE TAX CONFORMITY AND REVISION TEMPORARY AMENDMENT ACT OF 2025
sentences: I hope this resolution inspires California's leaders to come to their senses and allow the full relief of the important wins in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that provided the working families tax cuts to take effect for Californians.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H.J. Res. 142, disapproving of D.C.'s recent decision to decouple from key provisions of the Internal Revenue Code.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to support this resolution because workers and families in D.C., California, and across the country deserve a chance to get ahead.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AFFORDABLE HOUSING OVER MANDATING EFFICIENCY STANDARDS ACT
statements.title: AFFORDABLE HOUSING OVER MANDATING EFFICIENCY STANDARDS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I am proud to stand in support of H.R. 5184, the Affordable HOMES Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
statements.title: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
sentences: Doug was larger than life, but what I will remember most is how he lived big in the small moments with warmth, attention to detail, and genuine kindness.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMOTING RESPONSIBLE OVERSIGHT TO ELIMINATE COMMUNIST TEACHINGS FOR OUR KIDS ACT
statements.title: PROMOTING RESPONSIBLE OVERSIGHT TO ELIMINATE COMMUNIST TEACHINGS FOR OUR KIDS ACT
sentences: The Chinese Communist Party is executing the most sophisticated global influence campaign of our time.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill and stand firm against foreign indoctrination in American schools.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 1069, the PROTECT Our Kids Act.
We cannot allow an authoritarian regime that censors information, rewrites history, and silences dissent to have any role in American education.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO NEW BURMA FUNDS ACT
statements.title: NO NEW BURMA FUNDS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 4423, the No New Funds for Burma Act.
I urge my colleagues to join us in condemning the ongoing violence in Burma and supporting this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DENOUNCING THE HORRORS OF SOCIALISM
statements.title: DENOUNCING THE HORRORS OF SOCIALISM
sentences: North Korea is trapped in darkness.
As a Member of Congress, I will always fight for the American Dream and for our free market system that keeps it within reach for everyday Americans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Keeping our government open means protecting servicemembers, honoring veterans, supporting mothers and infants, keeping our border secure, and helping small businesses access the loans they need.
As we approach the government funding deadline, I support this clean, short-term continuing resolution.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to do the right thing, put the American people first, and support this measure.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING APPROPRIATE RECOGNITION AND TREATMENT NEEDED TO ENHANCE RELATIONS ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING APPROPRIATE RECOGNITION AND TREATMENT NEEDED TO ENHANCE RELATIONS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H.R. 4490, the PARTNER Act.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to co-lead this bill with Representative Castro, and I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AUKUS REFORM FOR MILITARY OPTIMIZATION AND REVIEW ACT
statements.title: AUKUS REFORM FOR MILITARY OPTIMIZATION AND REVIEW ACT
sentences: Since its inception in 2021, AUKUS has been key to our collective defense strategy, promoting cooperation on cutting-edge technologies like nuclear-powered submarines, artificial intelligence, and hypersonic systems.
This week, Xi Jinping is hosting Iran, North Korea, Russia, and other hostile actors for a military parade.
Mr. Speaker, I thank the Foreign Arms Sales Task Force co-chairs, Representatives Zinke and Dean, for leading this bill with me.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my bill, H.R. 4233, the AUKUS Reform for Military Optimization and Review Act, or the ARMOR Act.

I urge my colleagues to support this bill to send a strong message to our adversaries and friends alike that the United States is serious about preserving a free and open Indo-Pacific with our allies.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UYGHUR POLICY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: UYGHUR POLICY ACT OF 2025
sentences: The Chinese Communist Party continues to deny its genocide against the Uyghurs and other ethnic minorities.
We know that forced sterilization, forced labor, brainwashing, and torture are rampant in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region.
Meanwhile, Uyghur human rights advocates and family members of detainees are intimidated and harassed by the CCP's transnational repression and espionage campaigns abroad.
I rise in strong support of my bill, H.R. 2635, the Uyghur Policy Act of 2025.
Mr. Speaker, I thank my colleague, Representative Ami Bera, for leading this bipartisan legislation with me, and I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SINGLE, UNIQUE ZIP CODES FOR CERTAIN COMMUNITIES
statements.title: SINGLE, UNIQUE ZIP CODES FOR CERTAIN COMMUNITIES
sentences: I rise in strong support of H.R. 3095, which directs the U.S. Postal Service to designate a unique ZIP Code for certain communities, including North Tustin in my district.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPROVING ACCESS TO SMALL BUSINESS INFORMATION ACT
statements.title: IMPROVING ACCESS TO SMALL BUSINESS INFORMATION ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bill, H.R. 3351, the Improving Access to Small Business Information Act.
Mr. Speaker, I thank Representative Gottheimer for working with me on this commonsense legislation, and I urge my colleagues from both sides of the aisle to support H.R. 3351.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONDEMNING THE VIOLENT JUNE 2025 RIOTS IN LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA
statements.title: CONDEMNING THE VIOLENT JUNE 2025 RIOTS IN LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H. Res. 516 to condemn the violent riots in Los Angeles this month, and I thank our brave law enforcement officers for keeping us safe.
It recognizes a right to assemble and protest peacefully, and it condemns unequivocally the violence perpetrated against Federal, State, and local law enforcement.
It also expresses gratitude to our local, State, and Federal law enforcement officers for bravely keeping our communities safe in the face of danger.

Do you stand with our law enforcement officers working to keep our communities safe and have the common sense to call out rioters who commit vandalism, violence, property damage, and other crimes in our streets?

We saw acts of arson, looting, property destruction, vandalism, blocking streets and highways, lighting cars on fire, shooting fireworks, throwing rocks at law enforcement vehicles, and even assaulting Federal and local police officers.

Again, this resolution recognizes the right to assemble and protest peacefully, condemns the violence against law enforcement, and calls on local and State officials to work with the Federal Government to restore peace.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAIWAN NON-DISCRIMINATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: TAIWAN NON-DISCRIMINATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Defense experts have identified that China could exploit Taiwan's financial system by raising tariffs, short-selling stocks, and freezing bank transfers.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my bill, H.R. 910, the Taiwan Non-Discrimination Act.
I urge my colleagues to vote in favor of H.R. 910 and send the Taiwanese people a strong message of solidarity and support for their democracy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STRENGTHENING THE QUAD ACT
statements.title: STRENGTHENING THE QUAD ACT
sentences: As you have heard, Mr. Speaker, the Quad comprises four nations: the United States, Japan, India, and Australia.

It is the cornerstone of our strategy to promote a free and open Indo-Pacific, counter the Chinese Communist Party, or CCP, and maintain stability and U.S. interests in what the Department of Defense has deemed the priority theater.

Against the backdrop of the CCP's militarization of the South China Sea, coercive economic practices, and territorial disputes, the Quad amplifies our four democracies' deterrence and economic, defense, and technological cooperation.

Now is the time to ramp up the Quad's collaboration on maritime security, cybersecurity, and efforts to counter disinformation to protect our allies and friends, especially the Pacific Island nations.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H.R. 1263, the Strengthening the Quad Act.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to co-lead this important legislation with Representative Meeks, and I urge all my colleagues to support the Strengthening the Quad Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPROVING VA TRAINING FOR MILITARY SEXUAL TRAUMA CLAIMS ACT
statements.title: IMPROVING VA TRAINING FOR MILITARY SEXUAL TRAUMA CLAIMS ACT
sentences: They are also not required to undergo annual sensitivity training to reduce the risk of retraumatizing survivors of MST.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my bill, H.R. 2201, the Improving VA Training for Military Sexual Trauma Claims Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the Improving VA Training for Military Sexual Trauma Claims Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
statements.title: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
sentences: Unfortunately, we see this year after year with Members of Congress making lucrative stock trades while their constituents struggle to make ends meet.
There is no reason why Members of Congress should be able to trade stocks while in office, period.
That is why I am proud to have helped introduce the TRUST in Congress Act.
This bipartisan bill would prohibit Members of Congress, in addition to their spouses and children, to trade stocks while in office.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOTEL FEES TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: HOTEL FEES TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my bill, H.R. 1479, the Hotel Fees Transparency Act.

Mr. Speaker, I thank Representatives Castor, Fry, and Mullin for their collaboration on this bipartisan, commonsense, pro-consumer legislation, and I urge my colleagues to support the Hotel Fees Transparency Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THANKING ALEX CISNEROS, LEGISLATIVE DIRECTOR
statements.title: THANKING ALEX CISNEROS, LEGISLATIVE DIRECTOR
sentences: We will miss Alex, but he will always be a part of our family. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GRID RELIABILITY
statements.title: GRID RELIABILITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as Governor Newsom pushed to ban gas-powered cars, he then said people couldn't charge electric cars as our community saw rolling blackouts.
I will keep fighting to bring commonsense energy policies to Congress.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CREDIT UNION BOARD MODERNIZATION ACT
statements.title: CREDIT UNION BOARD MODERNIZATION ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H.R. 975, the Credit Union Board Modernization Act.

I commend my colleagues, Representatives Huizenga and Vargas, for reintroducing this commonsense piece of legislation, and I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 975 and eliminate burdensome regulations to let credit unions do what they do best, which is to service their communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENDING THE FENTANYL CRISIS
statements.title: ENDING THE FENTANYL CRISIS
sentences: In Congress, I have been working hard on commonsense solutions to keep our communities safe.

That is why I proudly voted for the HALT Fentanyl Act, which passed the House, to give our law enforcement the tools to crack down on drug traffickers and transnational criminal organizations funneling fentanyl onto our streets and into our schools.
I will keep doing all I can to secure our border and put an end to the fentanyl crisis that is taking the lives of too many Americans. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIX OUR FORESTS ACT
statements.title: FIX OUR FORESTS ACT
sentences: Mr. Chair, I rise in strong support of H.R. 471, the Fix Our Forests Act.

The Fix Our Forests Act includes the Wildfire Technology Demonstration, Evaluation, Modernization, and Optimization, or DEMO Act, which I introduced to create a public-private partnership to test and deploy emerging wildfire mitigation technologies.
Mr. Chair, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on H.R. 471.
